name: Annah
title: NOA Town Guard
description: A town guard who protects NOA's security. She is cheerful and sociable, but always approaches her duties as a town guard with seriousness.
introduction:
A cheerful town guard who works to maintain NOA's public order.

Often misunderstood due to her bright smile and willingness to engage anyone in friendly chatter, she takes her duties more seriously than one would expect.
While on duty, she boasts an impressive arrest rate thanks to her remarkable tracking ability and skill with a baton.
In her own words, "<color=#2A80D8>All I have to do is close my eyes and follow the scent, and I naturally end up right in front of the culprit!</color>"

On her days off and during lunch breaks, she is most often found at a nearby donut shop.
